MRD

Designed and productionized circulating tumor DNA–based Minimal Residule Diesase (MRD) pipelines (study design → feature engineering → data analysis → statistical reporting).
Delivered 4 clinical MRD studies and translated results into regulatory-ready reports; one outcome presented at SGO 2024; co-authored 2 manuscripts (one published).
Analyzed whole-genome doubling (WGD) using low-pass whole genome sequencing (WGS) in ~1× coverage; standardized WGD definitions across four studies.
Built machine learning classifiers using platelet RNA-seq data to differentiate uterine sarcoma vs. leiomyoma; conducted end-to-end analysis workflow (RNA-seq preprocessing → feature engineering → model evaluation → biomarker detection).
Contributed to the national HRD reference standard project led by China’s National Institutes for Food and Drug Control.

title: Siwen Zhang
text:
Data Scientist & Bioinformatics Engineer based in Amsterdam, focusing on translational medicine and AI-driven health analytics.
Hi there, welcome to Siwen’s website!
I’m a data scientist with a passion for translating complex biological data into actionable insights. My background in bioinformatics and machine learning has allowed me to develop innovative solutions for a variety of healthcare challenges. I’m excited to share my work and collaborate with others in the field to drive progress in translational medicine.

My story
I design and productionize analytical workflows that translate multi-omics and clinical signals into actionable diagnostics. Over the last seven years I have led machine learning and bioinformatics programs for tumor and rare disease detection, pathogen surveillance, and cell and gene therapy support. I thrive at the interface of R&D and engineering-pairing rigorous statistics with scalable pipelines so clinicians and regulatory teams can trust the science.
Currently, I am preparing for my MSc in Data Science at Leiden University (2025–2027). Previously, as a Middle Bioinformatics Engineer at Precision Scientific and GrandOmics Biosciences, I built MRD analytics, whole-genome doubling QC strategies, targeted capture assays, and pathogen intelligence systems used across oncology and infectious disease portfolios. Earlier, at Geneis Beijing, I co-developed liquid-biopsy MSI assays and translational biomarker pipelines for lung and gastric cancer studies.
I’m open to collaborations around clinical AI, translational data science, and digital health productization-feel free to drop me a note at aristazhang521@outlook.com or call (+31) 0626049080.


Key focus areas

Translational bioinformatics & computational genomics
Liquid biopsy & cfDNA & Minimal residual disease (MRD)
Cell therapy & pathogen surveillance data analytics
AI/ML for disease diagnostics
Multi-omics data integration & visualization



Professional snapshot

Precision Scientific (2021–2024): Led MRD analytics, viral vector QC, and ML classifiers for gynecological oncology studies; contributed to national HRD reference standards.
GrandOmics Biosciences (2019–2021): Built China’s first targeted capture product on long-read sequencing, pathogen surveillance systems on Galaxy, and benchmarking suites across NGS/TGS platforms.
Geneis Beijing (2017–2019): Developed targeted amplification panels and CNV/MSI analytics spanning lung, gastric projects, and multi-omic studies on mice germ cells.



Education

MSc Data Science (Computer Science) - Leiden University, The Netherlands (2025–2027)
MSc Bioinformatics - The University of Edinburgh, UK (2015–2016)
BEng Biomedical Engineering - Northeastern University, China (2011–2015)



Certifications
